description: Source code for FastAPI endpoints managing user files, including listing, uploading, and deleting files. Interacts with Supabase storage and database, enforces file types and size limits, and handles user session verification.

methods.name: Client get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client configured with environment variables.

methods.name: str _ext(name: str)
methods.description: Extracts the file extension from a filename, returns in lowercase including the dot.

methods.name: list_files(session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter files by session ID"), user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list files owned by the current user, optionally filtered by session_id.

methods.name: upload_file( session_id: str = Form(..., description="Target session ID"), upload: UploadFile = File(..., description="File to upload (.docx, .pdf, .txt, .xlsx)"), user=Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to upload a file, validates extension and size, stores in Supabase storage, and inserts metadata record.

methods.name: delete_file(file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a specific file by ID, verifying ownership and removing storage object and metadata.

methods.name: delete_session_file(session_id: str, file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a file associated with a specific session, verifying ownership and session.

ctags.name: list_files
ctags.pattern: /^def list_files(session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter files by session ID")/
ctags.signature: (session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter files by session ID"), user=Depends(get_current_user))
